up: Find all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725217'. Return the molecule's preferred name (pref_name) and ChEMBL ID (chembl_id). Join the docs table with compound_records on doc_id, and then join compound_records with molecule_dictionary on molregno. Apply a filter where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725217'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725217'
